root_cause_summary: orders.amount_cents is already in cents, but stg_orders.sql divides by 100 twice, so the mart reports 1/100th of the real count-weighted revenue. Source counts are steady at ~300/day; only the mart moved.

patch.transforms/stg_orders.sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, amount_cents / 100.0 AS amount_usd FROM orders;
